selection_scope: Performance protocol fixed before these derived inputs receive any new inference; not quality tuning or new independent acceptance.
threads_request: explicit 2/4; no core-count auto request; oversubscription on a 2-core emulator is possible
restarts: No intentional app restart within each three-case instrumentation batch; separate instrumentation invocations between batches.
sampling: Stage boundary PSS plus periodic RSS/PSS/thermal snapshots; not continuous peak memory. Sampler/instrumentation overhead and device conditions uncontrolled.
quality: Raw/normalized/cpWER and utterance-proxy DER reported separately for related repeats. No new gate, no pooling with dev/holdout/reserve, no natural-dialogue/ARM/speed causal claim.
